map.可选。普通 trim 只去半角空格与制表；全角空格（U+3000）需开启「含全角: Optional. A normal trim only removes half-width spaces and tabs; full-width spaces (U+3000) need the "include full-width" option, otherwise they remain at the ends.
map.默认只去首尾，保留词间空格；如需压缩为单空格请用「合并空白」选项，避免破坏正常排: By default only the ends are trimmed, keeping inter-word spaces; to compress to single spaces use the "merge whitespace" option, avoiding damage to normal layout.
map.处理顺序固定：先删除所有制表符（\\t → 空），再删除所有空格与制表符（[ \: Processing order is fixed: first remove all tabs (\t → empty), then remove all spaces and tabs ([ \t] → empty), then collapse consecutive spaces into one ([ ]+ → space); next process line by line — trim each line, collapse consecutive blank lines into one, or delete all blank lines outright, then join back with \n; finally strip leading whitespace (^\s+) and trailing whitespace (\s+$). When the result is empty, show "(no content)"
